current_prompt.body:
RUN the First Fit algorithm on Items = [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] with bin capacity C = 10 and REPORT the resulting packing.
FIND an optimal packing of the same items that minimizes the number of bins and REPORT that packing.
CALCULATE the gap between the number of bins used by First Fit and the optimal packing and EXPLAIN why the given arrival order causes First Fit to use more bins.
INCLUDE a self-test that VERIFIES both packings use all items exactly once and RESPECT the capacity constraint C = 10.
